task.pr_title: feat(header, footer): add ios fading header style

cases.provenance: A human reviewer flagged this defect in an inline comment on the reviewed pull request.
cases.description: Since this can run multiple times on the same component, does the scroll listener added in `checkCollapsibleFooter` need to be removed first to dedupe? Or is that handled through some other mechanism 🤔 (Also applies to `ion-header`)

evidence.thread_resolution: liamdebeasi: Oops yes we should destroy the scroll listener so there is no duplication. The header already has this logic: https://github.com/ionic-team/ionic-framework/blob/main/core/src/components/header/header.tsx#L68-L69
